 Projects

 AI & ML 

 AI and Agents

 Libraries for building AI applications, LLM integrations, and autonomous agents. 

- Agent Skills
 - django-ai-plugins - Django backend agent skills for Django, DRF, Celery, and Django-specific code review.
 - scientific-agent-skills - Agent skills for scientific research and analysis with Python libraries like scikit-learn, polars, and biopython.
 - sentry-skills - Agent skills the Sentry team uses for code review, pull requests, and Django reviews.
 - trailofbits-skills - Security skills for vulnerability detection, auditing, and testing.
 - wshobson-agents - Plugins, agents, and skills for AI coding tools, including Python skills for testing, async, packaging, and uv.
- Orchestration
 - langchain - A framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications.
 - langgraph - Low-level orchestration framework for building stateful, long-running LLM agents.
 - pydantic-ai - A Python agent framework for building generative AI applications with structured schemas.
 - crewai - A framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents for collaborative task solving.
- Vendor Agent SDKs
 - claude-agent-sdk - Anthropic's Python SDK for building AI agents on Claude Code's harness — custom tools, in-process MCP servers, hooks.
 - openai-agents - OpenAI's framework for building and managing AI agents.
 - google-adk - Google's code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying AI agents.
- Model Context Protocol
 - mcp - The official Python SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients.
 - fastmcp - A high-level, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.
- Code Sandboxes
 - pydantic-monty - A secure Python sandbox written in Rust for running AI-written code.
- Personal Assistants
 - hermes-agent - An adaptive personal AI assistant that grows with you.
 - AstrBot - A multi-platform AI assistant that connects LLMs to chat apps like Telegram, Slack, and QQ, extensible with Python plugins.
- Prompt Optimization
 - dspy - A framework for programming, not prompting, language models.
- Data Layer
 - instructor - A library for extracting structured data from LLMs, powered by Pydantic.
 - llama-index - A toolkit for building RAG pipelines and agents over your data.
 - mem0 - An intelligent memory layer for AI agents enabling personalized interactions.
 - openviking - A context database for AI agents that unifies memory, resources, and skills.
 - semantica - A graph-native context and knowledge layer for AI agents with reasoning, provenance, and governance.
- Pre-trained Models
 - transformers - The model-definition framework for pretrained models in text, computer vision, audio, video, and multimodal tasks, for inference and training.
 - sentence-transformers - Compute embeddings, run retrieval, and rerank results with pretrained and fine-tuned models.
- Local LLM Inference
 - ollama - Python client for Ollama, which downloads and runs open-weight LLMs locally.
 - llama-cpp-python - Python bindings for llama.cpp, for running GGUF models locally.
 - mlx-lm - Run and fine-tune large language models on Apple Silicon with MLX.
- LLM Serving
 - vllm - A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
 - sglang - A high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
 - deepinfer - DeepSeek's production inference engine for DeepSeek models, with MoE expert parallelism.
- Image and Video Generation
 - diffusers - Pre-trained diffusion models for generating and editing images, audio, and video.
- Fine-tuning
 - peft - A library for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pretrained models.
 - trl - A library for post-training transformer language models with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and other trainers.
 - unsloth - Faster, lower-memory LLM fine-tuning, as a Python library or a desktop app.
